# Complete Test Workflow for m6Aswitch

This script demonstrates the full m6Aswitch pipeline with synthetic but realistic data.
**You can run this right now to test the package.**

## Installation

```r
# First, install the package
remotes::install_github("Tarunchikatipalli6/m6Aswitch")
library(m6Aswitch)
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
```

## Create Test Data

We'll create realistic synthetic data that mimics glioma samples.

```r
# ============================================================================
# 1. SYNTHETIC m6A SITES (mimics m6AnetAnalyzer output)
# ============================================================================

m6a_test_data <- data.table(
  transcript_id = c(
    "ENST00000001.1", "ENST00000001.1", "ENST00000001.1",
    "ENST00000002.2", "ENST00000002.2",
    "ENST00000003.3", "ENST00000003.3", "ENST00000003.3",
    "ENST00000004.4",
    "ENST00000005.5", "ENST00000005.5"
  ),
  position = c(
    100, 250, 500,
    150, 600,
    200, 450, 800,
    300,
    100, 700
  ),
  probability = c(
    0.92, 0.78, 0.65,
    0.88, 0.71,
    0.95, 0.82, 0.73,
    0.85,
    0.90, 0.68
  )
)

print("m6A Test Data (head):")
print(head(m6a_test_data, 3))
```

## Create Isoform Switches

```r
# ============================================================================
# 2. SYNTHETIC ISOFORM SWITCHES (mimics IsoformSwitchAnalyzeR output)
# ============================================================================

iso_switches_test <- data.table(
  gene_id = c("BRCA1", "TP53", "PTEN", "EGFR", "MYC"),
  isoform_a = c("ENST00000001.1", "ENST00000002.2", "ENST00000003.3", 
                "ENST00000004.4", "ENST00000005.5"),
  isoform_b = c("ENST00000001.2", "ENST00000002.3", "ENST00000003.4",
                "ENST00000004.5", "ENST00000005.6"),
  fdr = c(0.001, 0.01, 0.02, 0.001, 0.05)
)

print("Isoform Switches (test data):")
print(iso_switches_test)
```

## Create Transcript Sequences

```r
# ============================================================================
# 3. SYNTHETIC TRANSCRIPT SEQUENCES
# ============================================================================

iso_sequences_test <- data.table(
  isoform_id = c(
    "ENST00000001.1", "ENST00000001.2",
    "ENST00000002.2", "ENST00000002.3",
    "ENST00000003.3", "ENST00000003.4",
    "ENST00000004.4", "ENST00000004.5",
    "ENST00000005.5", "ENST00000005.6"
  ),
  sequence = c(
    "ACUGAACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGAACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGA",
    "ACUGAACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGAACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGAACUGACUGACUGA",
    "GAACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGAACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGAC",
    "GAACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGAACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGA",
    "ACUGAACUGACUGACUGAAAAAACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGACUG",
    "ACUGAACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGAC",
    "UGACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGAC",
    "UGACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGA",
    "ACUGAACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGAC",
    "ACUGAACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGACUGA"
  )
)

print("Sequences loaded: 10 isoforms")
```

## Run the Core Analysis

```r
# ============================================================================
# 4. RUN m6Aswitch CORE FUNCTIONS
# ============================================================================

# Parse m6A data
m6a_parsed <- parse_m6anet(m6a_test_data, probability_threshold = 0.5)
print("Parsed m6A sites:")
print(m6a_parsed)

# Parse isoform switches
iso_switches_parsed <- iso_switches_test  # Already in correct format
print("Isoform switches:")
print(iso_switches_parsed)

# *** CORE ANALYSIS: Integrate m6A with isoform switches ***
m6a_switches <- annotate_m6a_switches(
  m6a_sites = m6a_parsed,
  iso_switches = iso_switches_parsed,
  iso_sequences = iso_sequences_test
)

print("\n=== m6Aswitch Results ===")
print(m6a_switches)
```

## Annotate DRACH Motifs

```r
# ============================================================================
# 5. ADD DRACH MOTIF ANNOTATION
# ============================================================================

m6a_switches <- annotate_drach(m6a_switches, iso_sequences_test)

print("m6A switches with DRACH annotation:")
print(m6a_switches)
```

## Generate Summary Report

```r
# ============================================================================
# 6. GENERATE SUMMARY REPORT
# ============================================================================

report <- generate_summary_report(m6a_switches, output_file = "m6aswitch_test_report.txt")
cat("\n=== Summary Report ===\n")
print(report)
```

## Visualize Results

```r
# ============================================================================
# 7. CREATE PLOTS
# ============================================================================

# Summary plot: m6A fate distribution
p1 <- plot_m6a_switches(m6a_switches, plot_type = "summary")
print(p1)

# Heatmap: genes vs. m6A fate
p2 <- plot_m6a_switches(m6a_switches, plot_type = "heatmap")
print(p2)

# Gene-level detail plot
p3 <- plot_isoform_details(gene_id = "BRCA1", m6a_switches = m6a_switches)
print(p3)
```

## Export Results

```r
# ============================================================================
# 8. EXPORT RESULTS
# ============================================================================

output_files <- export_annotated_switches(
  m6a_switches,
  output_prefix = "m6aswitch_test_results",
  format = "both"
)

print("Exported files:")
print(output_files)

# Read back the CSV to verify
results_csv <- data.table::fread("m6aswitch_test_results.csv")
print("CSV Export (first 5 rows):")
print(head(results_csv, 5))
```

Fate distribution:

- `m6aswitch_test_results.csv` — Full annotation table

### **Plots**
- Summary bar chart of m6A fates
- Heatmap showing gene×fate relationships

## Run with Your Own Data

Once you've tested this workflow, replace the synthetic data with your actual files:

```r
# Load your real m6A predictions
m6a_real <- parse_m6anet("path/to/your/m6anet_predictions.csv", 
                          probability_threshold = 0.5)

# Load your real isoform switches
iso_switches_real <- parse_isoform_switch("path/to/your/isoform_switches.txt",
                                          fdr_threshold = 0.05)

# Load your transcript sequences
iso_sequences_real <- data.table::fread("path/to/your/sequences.csv")

# Run the full analysis
m6a_switches_real <- annotate_m6a_switches(m6a_real, iso_switches_real, iso_sequences_real)
m6a_switches_real <- annotate_drach(m6a_switches_real, iso_sequences_real)

# Export results
export_annotated_switches(m6a_switches_real, output_prefix = "my_glioma_analysis")
```

---

## Troubleshooting

**Issue: `Error: cannot find function "parse_m6anet"`**
- Solution: Make sure you installed and loaded the package: `library(m6Aswitch)`

**Issue: `Error: object 'm6a_test_data' not found`**
- Solution: Run all data creation steps in order

**Issue: Package installation fails**
- Try: `remotes::install_github("Tarunchikatipalli6/m6Aswitch", dependencies = TRUE)`
